  {"step":4,"file":"src/jplist.c","function":"parse_primitive","line":435,"var":"endp","code":"long long intpart = strtol(str_val, &endp, 10);","note":"strtol reads from the non-terminated attacker buffer and may scan past the token boundary into adjacent memory."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/jplist.c","function":"parse_primitive","line":437,"var":"endp","code":"if (endp >= str_end) {","note":"The parser compares the returned pointer against the token end, but only after the library call has already performed the read."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/jplist.c","function":"parse_primitive","line":450,"var":"dval","code":"double dval = atof(str_val);","note":"For floating-point primitives, atof is called on the same unterminated pointer, creating the out-of-bounds read sink that can crash."}
